edges.reason: msg.sender is used in the constructor to mint reflections and set the initial owner.
transfer uses _msgSender() as the sender of the transfer.
transferFrom uses _msgSender() as the spender for allowance reduction.
approve uses _msgSender() as the allowance owner.
msg.sender flows into _transfer as the from address and affects fee/limit branches.
manualswap checks _msgSender() against development and marketing addresses as a permission gate.
manualsend checks _msgSender() against privileged addresses before sending ETH.
setTrading is owner-only, gated by msg.sender equality in onlyOwner.
setFee is owner-only; msg.sender must equal _owner to modify fees.
setMaxWalletSize is owner-only, authorized through msg.sender.
excludeMultipleAccountsFromFees is owner-only and affects fee exemptions.
renounceOwnership is owner-only, guarded by msg.sender comparison.
transferOwnership is owner-only and reassigns ownership to newOwner.
block.timestamp is used as the swap deadline, creating a timestamp dependency.
_isExcludedFromFee mapping determines whether fees are taken in _transfer.
uniswapV2Router is called to perform the token-to-ETH swap.
uniswapV2Pair determines buy/sell direction and swap triggering in _transfer.
bots mapping is read to blacklist senders and recipients in _transfer.
_maxTxAmount constrains the transfer amount in _transfer.
_maxWalletSize constrains recipient balance in _transfer.
_marketingAddress is the destination of the ETH transfer in sendETHToFee.
transfer delegates execution to _transfer.
transferFrom calls _transfer before reducing allowance.
transferFrom updates allowance through _approve.
_transfer finalizes with _tokenTransfer after fee selection.
_transfer may call swapTokensForEth when the swap conditions are met.
_transfer calls sendETHToFee when the contract holds ETH after a swap.
_tokenTransfer executes the standard transfer routine.
_transferStandard takes the team portion via _takeTeam.
_transferStandard reflects the fee via _reflectFee.
_transferStandard computes values via _getValues.
_getValues calls _getTValues for token-side fee math.
_getValues calls _getRValues for reflection-side math.
_getValues obtains currentRate from _getRate.
_getRate derives supplies from _getCurrentSupply.
_reflectFee performs unchecked-style _rTotal subtraction and _tFeeTotal addition driving reflection arithmetic.
_getRValues multiplies amounts by currentRate, feeding reflection arithmetic.
_getTValues multiplies and divides amounts to derive fees.
_transferStandard adds/subtracts reflection balances and feeds arithmetic-sensitive state.
swapTokensForEth performs the external router swap call.
External router call returns control into the transfer flow, allowing reentrant state reads/writes.
sendETHToFee forwards ETH to the marketing address.
ETH transfer to an external address can reenter the token transfer logic.
Constructor invokes the factory createPair external call.
removeAllFee zeroes the active _redisFee.
removeAllFee zeroes the active _taxFee.
restoreAllFee restores the previous _redisFee value.
restoreAllFee restores the previous _taxFee value.

normalization_plan.reason: The to parameter is only meaningful inside _transfer where recipient checks and wallet caps apply.
The amount parameter is used only within transfer/_transfer limit and fee logic.
recipient is a transient alias for the transfer destination inside transferFrom.
from is local to _transfer and drives fee/limit branching.
tokenAmount only exists to parameterize the ETH swap call.
tAmount is passed straight into the reflection value computation.
newOwner is consumed only by the ownership transfer routine.
account is a read-only argument of the balance lookup.
takeFee is forwarded directly into _tokenTransfer to skip fees.
currentRate is the immediate output of _getRate consumed by reflection math.
path is a transient array constructed only for the router swap.
Loop index is a purely synthetic counter over the blacklist array.
tFee is the fee token amount passed to and accumulated by _reflectFee.
rAmount is the reflection debit applied to the sender balance.
Temporary ETH balance forwarded to the fee address.
Net token amount emitted in the Transfer event.
Reflection credit applied to the recipient balance.
tTeam is the team share consumed by _takeTeam.
